37.desc:
Live Rosin is a solventless concentrate made using fresh frozen cannabis plant material. The
frozen plant material is first put through an ice water extraction process which separates the
trichome glands from the plant material. Those trichome glands are then dried using extremely
cold temperatures to remove the moisture. Once dried, the collection of trichome glands are
pressed through a 25 micron filter utilizing heat and pressure to melt the rest away from the
trichome glands and plant material. The result is an un-adulterated form of cannabis resin that
is a direct representation of the cultivar used to make it.
All Rosin is resin but not all resin is rosin. Rosin gets its name due to how it's made. A
concentrate can only be called rosin if the concentrate was made using heat and pressure to
separate the resin from plant material.
This Live Rosin was crafted from fresh frozen flower expertly cultivated by Clade 9, this Live
rosin vape delivers a pristine flavor and cannabinoid profile with uncompromising quality. Made
by using only ice water, heat and pressure capturing the most unadulterated expression of the
plant's terpene rich profile for a clean flavorful hit every time.

Storage and transport information:
1.) Store in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunlight. Refrigeration Recommended
for freshness and texture preservation.
2.) Melt products are transported using temperature-controlled procedures to preserve quality
consistency and compliance

38.desc: Rosin is a form of concentrate that uses heat and pressure to extract cannabinoids, rather than solvents. Depending on the source material used for the extraction, rosin can vary widely in clarity and consistency.

39.desc: For our Cold Cure, we collect the rosin from the press and put it all together in one big jar. We then allow the natural process of separation and buddering to occur before we finally whip the rosin together and put it back into cold storage. The consistency of the Cold Cure is a smooth, slightly wet batter.

343.desc: Cured Resin is a firm glass-like cannabis concentrate made from, as its name would suggest, cured and dried cannabis flower. From there, that cannabis material is boiled down to a powerful, potent concentrate by using a solvent solution to get rid of the organic aspects of that cured cannabis, leaving behind the THC, CBD, and other cannabinoids.

344.desc:
“Diamonds” from Strike is not a flower strain but a high-potency, crystalline concentrate line, typically sold as THCA diamonds in a 1 g format. These diamonds are a form of cannabinoid isolate, made by isolating and purifying THC-A into sparkling, gem-like crystals, often with nearly pure cannabinoid content and little to no CBD, emphasizing maximum psychoactive potential. They can be used on their own for dabbing or are sometimes paired with terpene-rich “sauce” to reintroduce flavor and a more rounded terpene profile.

The experience tends to be intense and fast-acting, with a rapid, full-body high that can feel heavy and deeply relaxing, especially for intermediate and advanced users. Many people use Strike Diamonds when they want a clean, punchy hit with little plant-matter flavor, letting the terpene additives or the strain used in the extract carry the taste and entourage effects. Because of their strength, they’re usually recommended for experienced consumers who already know how they respond to high-potency concentrates and who want a compact, efficient way to achieve a strong, focused session.

345.desc: Concentrated cannabis products come in a wide variety of consistencies, compositions, and potencies. Cannabinoids are isolated and removed from plant material via extraction, agitation, compression, or other methods to create generally a very potent product. Concentrates have an immediate activation time and are generally used by experienced consumers.

346.desc:
Live Rosin is a solventless concentrate made using fresh frozen cannabis plant material. The
frozen plant material is first put through an ice water extraction process which separates the
trichome glands from the plant material. Those trichome glands are then dried using extremely
cold temperatures to remove the moisture. Once dried, the collection of trichome glands are
pressed through a 25 micron filter utilizing heat and pressure to melt the rest away from the
trichome glands and plant material. The result is an un-adulterated form of cannabis resin that
is a direct representation of the cultivar used to make it.
All Rosin is resin but not all resin is rosin. Rosin gets its name due to how it's made. A
concentrate can only be called rosin if the concentrate was made using heat and pressure to
separate the resin from plant material.
This Live Rosin was crafted from fresh frozen flower expertly cultivated by Clade 9, this Live
rosin vape delivers a pristine flavor and cannabinoid profile with uncompromising quality. Made
by using only ice water, heat and pressure capturing the most unadulterated expression of the
plant's terpene rich profile for a clean flavorful hit every time.

Storage and transport information:
1.) Store in a cool, dry place away from heat and direct sunlight. Refrigeration Recommended
for freshness and texture preservation.
2.) Melt products are transported using temperature-controlled procedures to preserve quality
consistency and compliance

357.desc:
Cannabinoid Breakdown & Dosage

The "Trifecta 2:2:1" ratio means that for every 2 parts of CBD and CBN, there is 1 part of THC. 
Per Piece Dosing: Each individual fruit chew contains 10mg CBD, 10mg CBN, and 5mg THC.
Total Package Content (10-pack): The entire package delivers a total of 100mg CBD, 100mg CBN, and 50mg active THC. (Note: The "100mg" label on the package typically highlights the main therapeutic components, CBD and CBN, while keeping the psychoactive THC component at a lower 50mg total threshold to ensure sedation without overwhelming psychoactivity).

Targeted Effects
This specific cannabinoid profile leverages the "entourage effect" to promote healthy rest: 
CBN (Cannabinol): Formed as THC breaks down, this minor cannabinoid is highly regarded for its deeply sedative properties and ability to ease restlessness.
CBD (Cannabidiol): Works heavily with the body's endocannabinoid system to assist with physical relaxation, tension release, and reducing bedtime irritability. 
THC (Tetrahydrocannabinol): Present in a lower, controlled dose to help initiate sleep and enhance the overall therapeutic efficacy of the non-psychoactive cannabinoids.

Product Features
Dietary-Friendly: These fruit chews are 100% Vegan, Gluten-Free, and Dairy-Free.
Clean Ingredients: Formulated with real fruit flavors and contain no high-fructose corn syrup.
Flavor Profile: A sweet, ripe, and juicy watermelon flavor that masks the taste of the hemp extract. (A Sour Sleepy Watermelon variant is also available from the brand if you prefer a tangy finish). 

Consumption Tips
Onset Time: Because edibles are digested through the stomach and liver, effects typically take 45 minutes to 2 hours to fully manifest. It is highly recommended to take them roughly an hour before you plan to sleep. 
Dosing Advice: If you are new to THC or CBN, consider starting with half a chew (2.5mg THC / 5mg CBD / 5mg CBN) to gauge your personal sensitivity before moving to a full piece.

597.desc: Concentrated cannabis products come in a wide variety of consistencies, compositions, and potencies. Cannabinoids are isolated and removed from plant material via extraction, agitation, compression, or other methods to create generally a very potent product. Concentrates have an immediate activation time and are generally used by experienced consumers.

598.desc: Live Resin is a unique form of concentrate in that the flower used is frozen immediately after harvest, rather than the typical process of curing. Freezing the raw cannabis flower helps preserve terpene and cannabinoid profiles, providing consumers with a robust flavor profile and precise effects.

599.desc: Rosin is a form of concentrate that uses heat and pressure to extract cannabinoids, rather than solvents. Depending on the source material used for the extraction, rosin can vary widely in clarity and consistency.

600.desc: Shatter is a form of concentrate that is made by extracting cannabinoids and terpenes from cured cannabis flower. Shatter is translucent and stable at room temperature, but can range in consistency from very brittle to having a "pull-n-snap" quality.

694.desc:
Lookah Snail is one of the best 510 thread batteries. It is smaller than most pen-style batteries and compatible with all types of 510 units. 

The Lookah Snail features a 350mAh battery capacity with a 510 thread connection. The snail doesn't have temperature control heat settings; instead, it uses three variable voltage settings for the facility regulation. This is a similar way many mods work. The snail is not draw-activated but has a preheat mode.

The Lookah Snail features easy single-button operation.
Five (5) clicks will turn the unit on or off.
Three (3) clicks will adjust between three different voltage settings 3.2V - 3.6V - 4.2V. 
The integrated 350mAh battery is protected from over-time running, short-circuit, over-wattage, or overcharging. 
Once the voltage is running low, the LED blinks ten times to remind the user to charge the battery. After showing the low-power alert three (3) times, the system will lock the device until it has been recharged. 

The Lookah Snail pen batteries are charged through the Micro-USB port with a USB adapter at 0.5A. While charging, the LED light remains red, and once it's fully charged, the LED light will change color to green.
From fully charged, the Snail has a battery life of about 30 to 40 uses, depending on the battery voltage setting, what type of 510 thread units are being used, and the time for each hit. 

Package Content:
1 Snail Device
1 USB Cable
1 User Manual

The snail is not draw-activated but has a preheat mode.

The Lookah Snail features easy single-button operation.
Five (5) clicks will turn the unit on or off.
Three (3) clicks will adjust between three different voltage settings 3.2V - 3.6V - 4.2V. 
The integrated 350mAh battery is protected from over-time running, short-circuit, over-wattage, or overcharging. 
Once the voltage is running low, the LED blinks ten times to remind the user to charge the battery. After showing the low-power alert three (3) times, the system will lock the device until it has been recharged. 

The Lookah Snail pen batteries are charged through the Micro-USB port with a USB adapter at 0.5A. While charging, the LED light remains red, and once it's fully charged, the LED light will change color to green.
From fully charged, the Snail has a battery life of about 30 to 40 uses, depending on the battery voltage setting, what type of 510 thread units are being used, and the time for each hit. 

Package Content:
1 Snail Device
1 USB Cable
1 User Manual
